market_advice.title: Smart Buying (स्मार्ट खरीदी)
market_advice.message: Agle hafte Holi ka tyohar hai. Wholesale market me Maida aur Refined Tel ka rate abhi gira hua hai. Inhe aaj hi bulk me lijiye, munafa acha hoga.

financial_advice.title: Cash Flow Alert (खाता अलर्ट)
financial_advice.message: Aapke paas ₹15,500 liquid cash bacha hai aur ₹4,500 udhaari me hai. Naya stock uthane ke liye cash adequate hai, par nayi udhaari dene se bachein.

growth_advice.title: Dead Stock Warning (स्टॉक चेतावनी)
growth_advice.message: Aapka ₹1,700 'Premium Sabun' me fasa hai jo 65 din se nahi bika. Ise 10% discount par counter ke aage display karein taaki cash free ho sake.
